sections.heading: Put GST on the bill itself
paragraphs: The bill a retailer gets should carry the GST, with the rate and the HSN code on the same line. A separate invoice for the same sale only creates confusion.

sections.heading: Keep the rate and the HSN code right
paragraphs: Use the rate that applies to the item, and the HSN code for that item. The rate list is in the box above. If you are unsure about an item, ask your CA before you issue the invoice.

sections.heading: Give your CA a clean export
paragraphs: At month end, give your CA an export of your invoices, so your CA can work from your books.

summary: What to put on a distributor GST invoice so your CA can file it without asking you twice.
title: GST invoice for a distributor: what your CA needs
